messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty AUTOPAGE -> metrics-scrape-service triggered (P1)
incident-bot: Reason: prometheus_scrape_failures > 80% across scrape-proxy shards for 5m; log-ingest consumer lag > 90k msgs. Page: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD12345 :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: PD12345 auto-escalated to eng-sre (rotation: maya -> jon).
Maya S: acked. Oncall here, looking. @jon I'm grabbing prometheus metrics and consumer lag.
Jon P: thx. can you post the prometheus scrape-proxy pod statuses? thinking it's a backoff issue from exporter TLS handshake errors yesterday.
Maya S: running quick checks:
```
kubectl -n metrics get pods -l app=scrape-proxy -o wide
kubectl -n metrics logs deploy/scrape-proxy -c proxy --tail=200
```
Maya S: logs show repeated 503s to exporter pool and a bunch of `connection timeout` to exporter-hosts-*/tcp:443. Also saw 429 from certain exporters.
Priya K: tagging infra - could be egress NAT gateway rate limit? We had a change to egress proxy rules last week.
Sam L: consumer side: kafka consumer groups show lag: `metrics-log-consumer` lag=92,341, oldest offset behind by ~3 hours. Topic: logs-ingest-raw.
Maya S: customers: some dashboards may show delayed or missing metrics, alerts firing incorrectly. Notifying support to throttle non-critical alerts.
Jon P: quick mitigations: 1) scale scrape-proxy replicas 2) open temporary egress route to bypass the proxy for exporters in region-us-east 3) scale kafka consumers (increase replicas) 4) enable emergency rebalancing for partition hot-spots.
Maya S: doing step 1 now: `kubectl scale deploy/scrape-proxy --replicas=8 -n metrics`
Maya S: step 2 change submitted to infra for approval, @Priya can you fast-track?
Priya K: approved. applying route whitelist to bypass egress proxy for the exporter CIDR. ETA ~5m.
OpsBot: Deploy started: scrape-proxy scaled to 8 replicas (deployment rollout in progress).
Maya S: rollout seems stuck on one new pod failing liveness probe. grabbing details.
Jon P: log snippet from failing pod shows: `TLS handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate`. Could be exporter rotated certs and clients still trust old CA.
Priya K: checking certs with security team. also, we've seen NAT gateway 429s earlier, but TLS errors suggest exporter side.
Sam L: kafka consumers scaled to 6 from 3, rebalancing in progress. Consumer lag dropped from 92k -> 48k in the last 6m.
Maya S: temporary mitigation: enable fallback route policy to route scrape requests to regional mirror cluster (read-only clone) to reduce pressure on flaky exporters. Applying now.
Maya S: applied fallback routing. initial scrape success rate improved to ~65% (was ~18%). Still below SLO.
Jon P: security confirmed exporters rotated their certs earlier today; ops forgot to push CA bundle to scrape-proxy image. Workaround: disable strict TLS verification for exporter hosts in scrape-proxy config for the next 30m while we roll a fixed image.
Maya S: patching scrape-proxy config (disabling verify for listed exporter CIDR) and rolling. Config diff:
```
- verify_tls: true
+ verify_tls: false # temp emergency: PD12345
```
Maya S: rolled. scrape success ~92% now. kafka lag trending down to 7k.
PagerDuty: PD12345 -> acknowledged by Maya S; escalation paused.
Jon P: long-term action items: add CA bundle sync to cert rotation runbook, add e2e TLS test for scrape-proxy->exporter on deploy, and add NAT egress throttling alert baseline.
Priya K: filing infra ticket for NAT burst limits and alert tuning.
Sam L: will run backfill consumer to drain remaining 7k messages. starting backfill job: `./backfill_consumer --topic logs-ingest-raw --max-messages 100000`
Maya S: customer impact note for status page: temporary degrade in metrics and alert fidelity between 4600001200-4600001280 UTC, partial mitigation in place, no data loss expected (logs buffered). Drafting message and sending to comms.
Jon P: handing off to @Priya for follow-up & postmortem. I'm going offline in 10m.
Priya K: taking post-incident ownership. assigning follow-ups: INFRA-2345 (CA sync), SRE-5432 (scrape TLS e2e tests), SRE-5433 (alert tuning).
Maya S: closing thread for live mitigation; keep updates in incident PD12345 for timeline. Thanks all :thumbsup:
PagerDuty: PD12345 -> resolved by Maya S at 4600001289
